scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application for a conventional home purchase loan for $355,000 over 360 months. Could you please let me know the status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your patience. Your application for a conventional home purchase loan in the amount of $355,000 over 360 months was approved, and the loan has been originated. If you have questions about any details or terms, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know that my application was approved! Could you tell me what my assigned interest rate is and what the total costs of this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your assigned interest rate is 6.375%. The total loan costs are $3,291.34. If you need more details about these items or have other questions, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you tell me whether there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution, or do I remain with your company?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features. Your loan has not been sold or transferred to another institution; it remains with our company.

dialogue.user: That’s good to hear — thank you for clarifying those details. One last question: could you tell me what my debt-to-income ratio was for this application, and what that means for my loan approval?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio for this application was between 30% and less than 36%. The DTI ratio is the percentage of your monthly gross income that goes toward debt payments. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I can’t provide details about how this specific DTI influenced your approval.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for explaining that—I appreciate the clear answers to each of my questions. I feel confident with the information you’ve provided and that my application was handled properly. <Satisfied>

Reason: The agent promptly and clearly answered all my questions, explained terms in plain language, and was respectful throughout the interaction. I felt well-informed about my loan approval and costs.
